scope: Selected real full-K linear and complete shared-GQA group. Software integer reference, not full model quality, integer nonlinear/state implementation or target timing.
source_bridge: observed FP32 -> checked S32Q20 with nearest-even; quantized to signed symmetric INT8 [-127,127]
scales: signed int8 dyadic exponent, W per output/K group, A per row/K group or calibration static, final Y per output from twice calibration max
rounding: exact RNE, one final saturation to signed i8 [-128,127]; no per-group premature RQ
partial: i32, Kgroup*127^2 < 2^31; checked i64 mixed-scale alignment; separate observed and sufficient format/actual-W bounds

attention.query: dynamic per-query S8, dyadic scale integer-derived after S32Q20 bridge
attention.KV_scale: per head/tensor calibrated, dyadic, frozen before evaluation
attention.queries: first4/last4 prefill positions plus32 cached decode positions, deduplicated
attention.softmax: FP64 exp/div floating fallback; observed scaling and actual causal/window mask, not all-integer softmax
attention.dot: NumPy i64 reference plus scalar independent dot witnesses; i32 partial admissibility and wide bounds explicitly reported

cost.bank_port: one128bit read/write per cycle lower bound only; no scheduled E2/PPA claim
cost.multiplier: S8xS8 only candidate, 16-bit operand via 3 balanced-radix128 signed8 limbs; 16x8=3 products,16x16=9 plus shifts/adds, no free INT16 or U8 path
cost.metadata: A/W/Y exponent bytes, coordinates and packet alignment included; initial W/source traffic separate and not free

local_screen.note: Inherited exploratory local screen only, not task-quality acceptance.
